checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, exhibiting the characteristic triangular shape and pointed snout typical of mustelids.
Both eyes are visible, appearing small, round, and dark/black, consistent with the taxonomy.
Ears are visible on top of the head; they are short, broad at the base, and rounded at the tips.
